title: Service: git-vouch-trqp HTTP endpoint
description: Separate executable, Python stdlib only (http.server), stateless: POST /authorization validates the TRQP request against the TRQP JSON schema, maps action->minimum tier per the decision bead, calls 'git vouch query', returns the TRQP response (authorized, time_requested, time_evaluated, message) and TRQP error responses per spec §Error Handling. Recognition endpoint returns a spec-conformant 'not supported' or minimal answer. Public data: no auth. Wire format per the spike (plain TRQP and/or Trust Task envelope). TLS terminated by a reverse proxy.
acceptance_criteria: Request/response validated against the TRQP JSON schemas from the ToIP spec repo (independent oracle); malformed input returns spec errors, never a 500 trace; no registry value reaches a shell.
notes: Review round 3 (2026-10-23). DONE: promotion-after-TIME covered by test_bot_era_signature_of_since_promoted_handle (bot at T0 -> false, human now -> true) on query's history-based tier/automation (vouch-faq3.11). Slow-client finding fixed by documenting it: Handler.timeout comment now says it limits each socket read, not a request (ponytail, with the upgrade path), and the module docstring and --bind help say a buffering reverse proxy must bound whole requests. tests/trqp: 131 pass on 3.12 and 3.9 (schema oracle mandatory); ruff check/format clean. REMAINING/BLOCKED: query --at emails are NOT from history. held_at judges endorsements on the current tree (core ponytail at git-vouch ~2037), but DESIGN TRQP Time says 'emails held then'. Reproduced: carol endorsed after T0 -> bridge authorized=true at T0. Needs Mark/core: (a) held_at reads endorsements at TIME (core lock), or (b) DESIGN says emails are judged on the current tree (docs lock). After the decision, add the hand-written bridge test (endorsed after T0: false at T0 under (a), true now), then close and commit git-vouch-trqp + tests/trqp/. The 16:59 comment's claim that emails come from history at TIME is wrong.
close_reason: git-vouch-trqp + tests/trqp committed; faq3.11/faq3.12 give tiers and emails at context.time; 178 bridge+query tests pass on 3.12 and 3.9
